Instructions:

If you want to set your custom costume first:
create a regular version of that costume, and save the width and height of it.

On the "template" costume add that costume, have in mind that there are invisible part of that costume which must stay. If you delete the existing square or the change costume or restart the project , the hacked costume will break. Because of that you must add something as placeholder , i.e. the costume must not be empty.

The new added costume must be at the center

Then when you want to change width and height of it use the "Go to width and height" custom block. But you must put the previously saved width and height at the place of "original width and height" so everything works as intended

The size 100% and 100% are original, the width and height can also be negative.
